children: The Canadian dollar strengthened against the greenback on Thursday, and the yield on benchmark government debt slipped.
was trading 0.4% higher at C$1.3787 to the greenback, or 72.53 U.S. cents, after trading in a range of 1.3766 to 1.3847.
Canadian government 10-year bond yields (CA10YT=RR) fell 0.7 basis points to 3.791%. The yield on similar U.S. government benchmark debt fell to 4.764%.
futures rose 29 cents to settle at $91.3 a barrel on Thursday.
